risks.description: Political and governance risk (Moderate), considering fragility, socio-political instability, violence and weak governance of beneficiary countries.
risks.mitigation: Close engagement by the World Bank to coordinate activities with other key partners.

risks.description: Technical design risk (Substantial), considering the complexities of coordinating national-level and regional-level activities to align and build on each other, and the different levels of readiness at country-level.
risks.mitigation: Exploring the possibility of a coordinated implementation arrangement with CEMAC as the lead technical coordination body for regional activities.

risks.description: Weak institutional capacity for implementation and sustainability (Substantial), combined with overstretched or nonexistent PIUs in respective countries.
risks.mitigation: Strengthening the existing PIUs and intensive capacity building and targeted TA for newly established PIUs.

risks.description: Fiduciary risk (Substantial) due to weak governance structures and inadequate FM systems.
risks.mitigation: Close implementation support by the World Bank, including TA as well as additional training and coaching on fiduciary processes.

risks.description: E&S risk (Substantial) given the security risks associated with service delivery in FCV (fragility, conflict, and violence) settings.
risks.mitigation: Close implementation support by the World Bank, including TA as well as additional training and coaching on managing E&S risks.

notes: Text-driven extraction: overall risk Substantial. Para 80 explicitly frames the register as exactly 5 risk clusters ('political and governance, technical design, institutional capacity for implementation and sustainability, E&S, and fiduciary'), and para 81 narrates all 5 as a lettered (i)-(v) list with per-item ratings and mitigations, matching R01-R05 exactly. NOTABLE GAP: Macroeconomic is rated Substantial in the SORT table (row 2) but is not included in para 80's list nor narrated anywhere in paras 80-82 - an unusual case of a Substantially-rated category left unnarrated (most unnarrated categories in this corpus are Moderate/Low); no entry is fabricated for it, consistent with the corpus-wide extraction rule. Stakeholders (Moderate) is also rated-but-unnarrated. Regional MPA covering Cameroon, CAR, Chad, Republic of Congo, and CEMAC - confirmed via full read of all 5 country annexes (pages 56-84) that no country-specific annex contains a separate itemized register (unlike Guatemala); only CEMAC and RoC annexes even mention 'key risks', each as a single incidental sentence, so the program-level section (46-47) is the only usable register.
